text:
Amy Li: Heads up — new org account for EU-WEST-3 (Paris) is live and we need quota increases for GPU instances. Primary ask: p5 family (p5.24xlarge) and secondary g5 (g5.12xlarge) so we can run a small Dedicated pool for staging.
Derek H: Which account ID and how many of each do we need to request?
Amy Li: Account ID 987654321000. Requesting p5 -> 4 instances to start (can scale later), g5 -> 6 instances. Also checking ENI and on-demand vCPU soft limits; might need bump on both.
Marie O: Do we have existing VPC peering / subnet limits in that region? AWS sometimes blocks new ENIs per AZ.
Amy Li: No existing peering. We'll create a fresh VPC. Please include ENI and EIP limits in the ticket. We also need support for attaching multiple ENIs per instance for monitoring agents.
infra-bot: Automated check: account 987654321000 current quotas in eu-west-3 -> p5: 0, g5: 0, vCPU On-Demand limit: 128, Elastic IPs: 5, ENIs per region default: 104. Recommendation: request p5=4, g5=6, vCPU=1024, EIP=20, ENI region=500.
Derek H: Sounds good. Who will open the AWS support case? I can do it but need the justification text.
Amy Li: I'll draft the request. Use "Production inference pre-provisioning for Redwood Dedicated staging cluster" as justification. Mention that instances will be used for inference serving and performance testing, link to internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-west-3-onboarding
CloudOps: Quick note — for p5 we should also request placement group permissions if we plan to launch them in a single AZ. AWS sometimes requires a quota increase for p5 in placement groups.
Marie O: Also add request to increase ENI per AZ to 250 and secondary private IP per ENI to 50 for network tooling.
Amy Li: Drafting case now. Proposed payload (paste into AWS case):
```
Account: 987654321000
Region: eu-west-3 (Paris)
Requested quotas:
 - p5 family (p5.24xlarge): 4
 - g5 family (g5.12xlarge): 6
 - On-Demand vCPU limit: 1024
 - Elastic IPs: 20
 - ENI per AZ: 250
 - Secondary private IPs per ENI: 50
Justification: Provisioning Dedicated staging inference cluster for Redwood. Instances used for low-latency LLM serving, smoke/perf tests, and model onboarding. Need predictable capacity before ramp. ETA to have infra ready: 3 business days after approval.
```
Derek H: I'll open the case and tag with priority "production capacity". Do we want to request a support plan escalation (dev -> business)?
Amy Li: Yes, escalate to Business support and request a response SLA of 24 hours. Also ask for a temporary quota hold so we can reserve capacity while we sign the Dedicated contract.
infra-bot: Note: when AWS processes GPU quota increases they sometimes require account verification docs. Keep legal/finance on standby.
Marie O: I can share the company's verification docs. Amy, assign me to the ticket once created and I'll upload.
Derek H: Case opened: AWS-CASE-2026-000123 (putting this here for trace). I'll add the justification block and request Business support. Ping once legal uploads docs.
Amy Li: Thanks! Once approved I'll kick off Terraform to provision subnets/placement groups and open an infra rollout run in the console. Schedule: start provisioning the week after approval, run validation tests, then move to canary.
CloudOps: Cost note — p5.24xlarge hourly is expensive. Let's gate default autoscaling to keep running costs low until Dedicated contract pricing applied. Put a budget alert on the account.
Amy Li: Will do. Creating a budget alarm and tagging instances with project=dedicated-euw3.
Marie O: Assigned to ticket and uploaded verification doc at 1769456890 in the ticket attachments.
infra-bot: Reminder: after quota approval, we should request instance capacity reservations or use Dedicated Hosts if we need guaranteed AZ-level capacity.
